enchantments.tooltip: Magical Efficiency 10%: You take a 10% Enhancement discount to the Spell Point cost of your spells.
Insightful Potency +34: Passive: +34 Insight bonus to each Spell Power.
Insightful Spell Resistance +13: +13 Insight bonus to Spell Resistance.
Insightful Will Save +4: This item gives a +4 Insight bonus to your Will saves.
Lost Purpose: This item is missing some parts that made it unique. Perhaps you can fix that at a Cannith Repurposing Station.
Mythic Cloak Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
